title: AI Agents for Personal Care Retailer Onboarding: Assemble Product and Packaging Documents
summary: A Genie matches a retailer's item list to NetSuite products, pulls approved product sheets and packaging data, and lists every field it could not verify.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


A personal-care onboarding Genie can assemble approved product sheets and packaging data for a retailer’s exact item list. It should match shade, size, set, and packaging revision and identify missing fields before drafting a response. The job gathers existing approved information; it does not invent specifications or certify retailer compliance.


Explore the complete[personal care integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/personal-care) for the systems and processes around this guide.
